items.title: Accuracy of Navigated Osteotomies in Rhinoplasty: A Cadaveric Analysis
items.content_html:
事实：9具尸头18侧电磁导航截骨，实际截骨线与规划平均偏差1.5mm，经鼻与经皮入路无差异。

点评：导航能把截骨做到亚毫米级，但尸头没出血没肿胀；真实价值在二次鼻和畸形鼻，不在常规截骨。

In nine cadaver heads, 18 electromagnetically navigated osteotomies deviated from the planned nasomaxillary suture by a mean of 1.5 mm, with transnasal and percutaneous routes equally accurate. Sub-millimeter accuracy in a bloodless cadaver model proves feasibility, not superiority; navigation earns its cost in revision and distorted anatomy, not routine osteotomy.

The Laryngoscope · PMID 42951306

items.title: Infraorbital versus sphenopalatine ganglion block for patient-reported recovery after septorhinoplasty: A randomized controlled trial
items.content_html:
事实：90例鼻中隔鼻整形RCT：眶下神经阻滞24小时QoR-15为129.1分，蝶腭神经节阻滞116.6分。

点评：眶下阻滞疼痛和恢复质量全面胜出，补救镇痛11%对53%；鼻整形术后镇痛该换默认选项。

In a 90-patient RCT, ultrasound-guided infraorbital block beat transnasal sphenopalatine ganglion block on 24-hour QoR-15 (129.1 vs 116.6), with rescue analgesia in 11.4% versus 53.3%. The margin exceeds the minimal clinically important difference and cuts rescue opioid use fivefold; infraorbital block deserves to become the default for septorhinoplasty.

Journal of Clinical Anesthesia · PMID 42950360

items.title: The V-Shaped Subdomal Graft: A Structural Template for Geometric Control of the Nasal Tip
items.content_html:
事实：PRS提出V形鼻小柱下移植物，用几何模板同时控制鼻尖宽度、高度与旋转。

点评：把鼻尖控制做成模板，说明手感难复制；思路值得学，但一块移植物解决不了所有鼻尖。

A PRS technique paper introduces a V-shaped subdomal graft as a geometric template for controlling tip width, height and rotation together. Template-driven tip surgery is valuable as a teaching scaffold, but it cannot replace diagnosing the underlying support deficit case by case.

Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery · PMID 42937516

items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Facelift Surgery: A Systematic Review of Objective Outcome Assessment and Patient-Perceived Rejuvenation
items.content_html:
事实：9项研究的系统综述：AI测得减龄1.7–5.8岁，比患者自感年轻程度低35%–50%。

点评：机器算出的岁数不能当疗效指标，患者照镜子那一眼才是；AI目前只能做辅助记录。

Across nine studies, AI age estimation after facelift showed 1.7 to 5.8 years of reduction but underestimated patient-perceived rejuvenation by 35% to 50%. Systematic discordance with patient perception means AI-derived age is a research metric, not an outcome measure to quote in clinic.

Aesthetic Plastic Surgery · PMID 42955309

items.title: Clinical Outcomes of Submuscular vs Subglandular Implant Placement in Primary Cosmetic Breast Augmentation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.content_html:
事实：12项研究4534例：肌下/双平面总体并发症OR 0.49，包膜挛缩OR 0.58，血肿OR 0.30。

点评：肌下赢在并发症，满意度和再手术率却没差别；腺体覆盖够的瘦病人，不必一刀切放肌下。

Pooling 12 studies and 4,534 patients, submuscular or dual-plane placement had lower odds of overall complications (OR 0.49), contracture (OR 0.58) and hematoma (OR 0.30), with no difference in satisfaction or reoperation. Lower complication odds are real, but unchanged satisfaction and reoperation mean implant plane should follow tissue coverage, not habit.

Aesthetic Surgery Journal · PMID 42969680

items.title: Association of Ultrasound-Guided PECS II Block with Postoperative Pain Scores and Recovery Outcomes in Subpectoral Breast Augmentation: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.content_html:
事实：48例胸肌下隆胸回顾：加PECS II阻滞后PACU疼痛评分1分对4分，无人需补救哌替啶。

点评：样本小、回顾性，但差距大得不像偶然；把PECS II写进常规镇痛，成本低收益明确。

In 48 subpectoral augmentations, adding a PECS II block cut PACU pain scores (median 1 vs 4) and eliminated protocol-driven rescue meperidine (0% vs 71.4%). Retrospective and small, but the effect size is too large to dismiss; PECS II is a cheap addition to standard multimodal analgesia.

Journal of Multidisciplinary Healthcare · PMID 42973786

items.title: Septorhinoplasty: The Open Approach
items.content_html:
事实：德国耳鼻喉科杂志刊出开放入路鼻中隔鼻整形专题，聚焦该入路的技术要点。

点评：开放入路的价值在复杂病例的暴露与固定，不该当默认术式；条件允许时，闭合入路仍值得先考虑。

A German ENT journal runs a focused piece on the open-approach septorhinoplasty and its technical points. The open approach earns its place in complex cases, not as a default; consider a closed approach first when anatomy allows.

Laryngo-Rhino-Otologie · PMID 42971217
items.summary: 德国耳鼻喉科杂志刊出开放入路鼻中隔鼻整形专题，聚焦该入路的技术要点。 开放入路的价值在复杂病例的暴露与固定，不该当默认术式；条件允许时，闭合入路仍值得先考虑。

items.title: The V-Shaped Subdomal Graft: A Structural Template for Geometric Control of the Nasal Tip
items.content_html:
事实：PRS 提出 V 形鼻尖下移植物，用一块可预判的软骨模板对鼻尖做几何化控制。

点评：模板化的价值在于可复制，但要盯住鼻尖投影的长期稳定性——这类文章最常见的坑是随访短、样本小。

PRS introduces a V-shaped subdomal graft as a predictable template for geometric tip control. Templates are only worth it if tip projection holds at 2+ years; check follow-up before adopting.

Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery · PMID 42937516

items.title: Accuracy of Navigated Osteotomies in Rhinoplasty: A Cadaveric Analysis
items.content_html:
事实：九具尸体、18 侧电磁导航截骨显示，导航能让截骨线更贴近鼻上颌缝。

点评：把「手感」变成可测误差是好事，但导航的机器成本和每台多出的 10 分钟，才是它进不了日间手术室的真实原因。

Electromagnetic navigation placed osteotomies closer to the nasomaxillary suture in nine cadavers (n=18). Turning feel into a measured error is progress; capital cost and added setup time remain the adoption barrier.

The Laryngoscope · PMID 42951306
items.summary: 九具尸体、18 侧电磁导航截骨显示，导航能让截骨线更贴近鼻上颌缝。 把「手感」变成可测误差是好事，但导航的机器成本和每台多出的 10 分钟，才是它进不了日间手术室的真实原因。

items.title: Infraorbital versus sphenopalatine ganglion block for patient-reported recovery after septorhinoplasty: a randomized controlled trial
items.content_html:
事实：90 例随机对照：眶下神经阻滞 vs 蝶腭神经节阻滞，主要终点是术后 24 小时恢复质量。

点评：这是能明天就改方案的那类证据——如果眶下阻滞不劣，操作更简单、超声引导更熟悉，值得换。

A 90-patient RCT compared infraorbital with sphenopalatine ganglion block on 24-hour recovery quality. Actionable now: if infraorbital block is non-inferior, it is easier to teach and to schedule.

Journal of Clinical Anesthesia · PMID 42950360

items.title: Prevention of Secondary Deformities at the Donor Site After Cartilage Transplantation
items.content_html:
事实：92 例耳软骨移植：术前耳模塑形 + 耳轮内侧切口，降低供区继发畸形。

点评：供区畸形是患者术后最常抱怨却最少被写进论文的部分，这篇给了可照做的流程。

In 92 patients, preoperative ear splinting plus antihelix-side incisions reduced donor-site deformity. Donor-site deformity is under-reported and over-complained about; this gives a repeatable protocol.

Journal of Craniofacial Surgery · PMID 42980382

items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Facelift Surgery: A Systematic Review of Objective Outcome Assessment and Patient-Perceived Rejuvenation
items.content_html:
事实：系统综述纳入 9 项研究，评估 AI 判断提升术后年轻化的客观性与患者主观感知的一致性。

点评：结论大概率是「AI 算得准、但和患者自己觉得好不好看不完全一致」——这正是咨询时最该讲的那句话。

Nine studies reviewed on AI-based age estimation and its concordance with patient-perceived rejuvenation. Expect a gap between algorithmic age gain and patient satisfaction; that gap is the consultation script.

Aesthetic Plastic Surgery · PMID 42955309
